scope: Ukraine medical discovery — Vinnytsia National Pirogov Memorial Medical University

institution.canonicalName: Vinnytsia National Pirogov Memorial Medical University

verifiedFacts.claim: The official Study in Ukraine portal identifies the university as state-owned and lists English-medium Medicine as six years, with a published USD 27,100 total across the six listed years.
The same government portal describes international admission dates up to 1 November and up to 30 December.

The university's foreign-citizen faculty says it is entitled to train foreign citizens, including General Medicine, and describes five hostels, dining facilities and a central-campus student polyclinic.
The faculty's admission page retains a 2022/23 fee table for English Medicine and says medical examination and insurance are additional, but this is historical evidence only.

holdReasons: The official programme fee page on the university domain is explicitly for 2022/23, while the government Study in Ukraine figures give no academic-year context. A current programme fee cannot be safely selected.
No current first-party foreign-Medicine admissions notice was found that aligns English instruction, entry requirements, documents, fee, class start and delivery mode for the 2026 cohort.
No independent current programme-accreditation/recognition record was established for the required recognition badges.

Because Ukraine's education system remains subject to war-related disruption, an international medical listing also requires institution-specific current clinical-delivery and continuity evidence; this was not located.
nextAction: Obtain VNMU's 2026/27 international Medicine contract or fee notice and admissions rules, including English delivery and clinical-continuity arrangements, then verify current independent accreditation before packaging.
